title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with a creamy sauce made from eggs, cheese, pancetta, and pepper.
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions.
Fry guanciale until crispy.
Whisk eggs and cheese with pepper.
Drain pasta, toss with egg mixture and guanciale.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken (tikka) cooked in a smooth buttery & creamy tomato-based gravy.
ingredients: 400g canned tomatoes (blended) or 3 fresh large tomatoes (pureed)
150ml heavy cream (or coconut cream for lighter option)
instructions: Mix yogurt, lemon juice, cumin, coriander, turmeric, chili powder, half the garlic, and ginger. Marinate chicken for at least 1 hour.
Cook chicken in a pan or grill until browned and slightly charred. Set aside.
In a pan, heat oil/ghee. Sauté onions until golden, add garlic, ginger, and garam masala, then stir in tomato puree and salt. Simmer 10 minutes.
Add chicken, simmer 10 minutes, then stir in cream and cook for 5 minutes.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.

title: Classic Beef Burgers
summary: Juicy beef patties served on toasted buns with fresh toppings.
instructions: Mix ground beef, onion, garlic, egg, breadcrumbs, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper. Shape into 4 patties.
Heat oil/butter in a pan or grill. Cook patties 3–4 minutes per side. Add cheese slices if desired.
Toast burger buns lightly on the grill or pan.
Assemble with sauces, lettuce, patty, tomato, onion, and pickles.
Serve with fries or salad.

title: Jollof Rice
summary: A popular West African one-pot dish made with rice, tomatoes, peppers, and spices.
instructions: Blend tomatoes, peppers, and onion into a smooth paste.
Heat oil in a pot, add chopped onions and fry until golden. Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2–3 minutes.
Add blended mixture, thyme, curry, bay leaves, and Scotch bonnet. Cook until sauce thickens and oil floats on top.
Pour in stock, season with salt and pepper, then stir in rice.
Cover tightly and cook on low heat until rice is tender and liquid absorbed.
Fluff rice with a fork and serve hot with chicken, beef, or fish.
